The primary material of a candle is wax.

Regarding the operational processes at AutoBuild, the centralization of tools and materials creates a significant bottleneck. The requirement for workers to travel long distances across the site to retrieve items leads to lost productivity. To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing resources by establishing smaller, localized tool and material stations closer to active construction areas. This would reduce travel time, minimize downtime, and allow workers to focus more on construction tasks rather than logistics.
